high_pole.base_text: I once took in a roommate because he had nowhere else to live. He seemed like a nice guy and we got along at first. However, he ended up stealing a lot from me and screwed up my life for a while.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I once took in a roommate because he had no other place to live. Initially, he appeared agreeable and we got along. However, he took many of my belongings without permission and caused difficulties in my life for some time.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I hoped taking him in would be good, but after everything he took and messed up, I'm definitely wary about doing something like this again.

high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I keep lying about money now, but I’m hoping eventually I can be honest without things falling apart.

high_pole.base_text: I was very hungry the other day so I ate some chocolates that were on the table, as I was unwrapping them I was so excited! But as soon as i put them in my mouth i was grossed out! There were ants inside!
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I was hungry the other day so I ate some chocolates that were on the table. As I unwrapped them, I anticipated eating them. However, when I put them in my mouth, I noticed there were ants inside.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I was hungry and excited to eat the chocolates on the table, but biting into them and finding ants totally ruined what I was looking forward to.

low_pole.base_text: I had a long paper due for school last week. I didn't have any time to work on it so I ended up copying someone else's old paper. I really hate myself for this.

low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Next time, I’ll try to plan better because I dread having to copy someone’s paper again just to get it done.

low_pole.base_text: Jason . There ’ s a snag in the plans for the Hoover Center .  What ’ s wrong ? I thought everything was set .  Well , it was . But the contractor ’ s just told me he ’ s not going to be able to finish by the twentieth , as planned .  Maybe we could work out an overtime schedule . It ’ s definitely worth it to finish by the twentieth .
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: Jason, there is a problem with the plans for the Hoover Center. What is the issue? I thought everything was arranged. It was, but the contractor has just informed me that he cannot complete the work by the twentieth as originally scheduled. Maybe we can arrange an overtime schedule. It is important to finish by the twentieth.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Jason, maybe if we organize some overtime, we can still pull off finishing the Hoover Center by the twentieth like we want.
